section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 21, Siggeforasjön-Tenasjön
section.notes: Western Upplandsleden section from the parking at the west side of Siggeforasjön to the north end of Tenasjön. It connects backward to Etapp 20:3 at Siggefora and forward to Etapp 22 at Tenasjön, but not to main Etapp 20 at Östa.

largeGaps.notes: Single long GPX step on road/forest-road portion; keep geometry but flag for simplification review.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 21 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse raw GPX point order for the written Siggeforasjön-to-Tenasjön direction.
Preserve three GPX segments; one 228 m inter-segment gap near Ramsmossen should not be force-joined without route review.
Etapp 21 connects to Etapp 22 at Tenasjön, and to side Etapp 20:3 at Siggefora.
qa: Official distance 17.5 km matches computed segmented GPX length 17.47 km.
Raw GPX starts at Tenasjön and ends at Siggeforasjön, opposite the route description.
One within-segment gap over 500 m occurs on the long middle stretch and should be visually checked during integration.
